description: A basic todo application that allows users to add tasks, prioritize them, and authenticate themselves using a secure login system.
vision: To provide an easy-to-use task management tool for individuals who need to organize their daily activities efficiently.
target_users: Individuals needing to manage personal tasks
Small business owners handling day-to-day operations

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: A system that allows users to sign up, log in, and securely store their credentials.

features.name: Task Management
features.description: A feature allowing users to add, edit, delete, and prioritize tasks. Tasks can be marked as completed or pending.

features.name: Task Prioritization
features.description: A system that enables users to assign priority levels (High, Medium, Low) to their tasks for better organization.

features.name: Task Filtering and Sorting
features.description: A feature that allows users to filter and sort their tasks based on various criteria such as priority, due date, or completion status.

user_stories.as_a: User who needs to manage daily tasks
user_stories.i_want: to be able to sign up for the app and log in with my credentials
user_stories.so_that: I can start using the application right away
acceptance_criteria: User can register a new account
User can login using their username and password

user_stories.as_a: User who wants to track personal tasks
user_stories.i_want: to add multiple tasks with different priority levels
user_stories.so_that: I can manage my daily activities more efficiently
acceptance_criteria: Tasks can be marked as High, Medium, or Low priority

user_stories.as_a: User who needs to prioritize their tasks
user_stories.i_want: to mark a task as completed and see it disappear from the list of pending tasks
user_stories.so_that: I can keep track of what I have accomplished during the day
acceptance_criteria: Completed tasks are removed from the active list

user_stories.as_a: User who wants to manage their tasks easily
user_stories.i_want: to filter and sort my tasks based on their priority or due date
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly find important tasks that need immediate attention
acceptance_criteria: Tasks can be filtered by priority
Tasks can be sorted by due date

non_functional_requirements.performance: The application should respond to user actions within 2 seconds. The database should handle up to 10,000 tasks per user efficiently.
non_functional_requirements.security: All user data must be encrypted both in transit and at rest. Passwords should be hashed using a strong hashing algorithm.
non_functional_requirements.scalability: The application should be able to handle an increase in users from 100 to 100,000 without significant performance degradation.
non_functional_requirements.availability: The application should have a minimum uptime of 99.9% with no more than one hour of downtime per month.

constraints: Must use a secure authentication method
Tasks must not exceed 255 characters in length
Priority levels must be limited to three options (High, Medium, Low)
assumptions: Users have basic internet connectivity and can access the application through web browsers
